task.text: For the rub ons, the photos you show look more like stickers. Which wouldn't be the same unfortunately. Rub on transfers do not have the clear area around the designs. And you need to adhere them by rubbing pressure over the area and peeling back the backing paper to reveal only the image design left behind on the paper.
